key_insight: The paper introduces WBCMor VQA, a bilingual English-Urd̄u visual question answering benchmark for white blood cell morphology to better support hematology AI in multilingual settings.
clinical_relevance: It addresses a real language gap in clinical communication and documentation, which could help make leukemia-related AI tools more usable in Urdu-speaking healthcare environments.
method: Built a morphology-aware VQA benchmark from LeukemiaAttri and WBCAtt datasets
Added clinically validated English-Urd̄u question-answer pairs using a domain-specific Urdu hematology dictionary
Evaluated multiple open-source vision-language models on the new benchmark
evidence_signal: The benchmark contains 110K bilingual question-answer pairs for 20K leukemic and normal single-cell images, with baseline model evaluation reported in the abstract.
watch_item: Because the resource is specialized to leukemia and white blood cell morphology, broader clinical use will still require careful validation across other diseases, imaging workflows, and Urdu medical terminology variants.
paper_title: Multilingual Hematology Visual Question Answering Dataset
